en: \[VSCode] Fixed Escape stopping Claude at a Remove or Delete confirmation in MCP, Hooks and Memory dialogs, on a side question panel's button or link, and on the Bookmarks button with its panel open
zh: \[VSCode] 修复了在 MCP、Hooks 和 Memory 对话框的移除或删除确认处、侧边问题面板的按钮或链接上，以及书签按钮及其面板打开时按 Escape 会停止 Claude 的问题
